content.title: Irreversible Cooking Chain | Ingredients to Taste Proof
content.summary: One cook advances the same ingredients through visible irreversible states before plating and tasting the result.

quick_start.input_format: One adult cook, kitchen and ingredient set persist. + Every step creates an observable state change. + Previous-state material remains available to the next step. + Tool and container identity stay stable. + Plating and tasting provide final proof.
quick_start.recommended_input: Pear and oat batter become a browned skillet pancake and are tasted.
required_anchors: Lock one clearly adult original cook, kitchen, ingredient set, primary vessel and hand or tool anchors.
Perform exactly one irreversible operation per beat and preserve visible residue into the next.
Keep food color, quantity and container transitions plausible through cooking and plating.
End with the same plated serving and one restrained taste by the same adult.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: One cook advances the same ingredients through visible irreversible states before plating and tasting the result.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 锁定同一成年厨师、厨房与主食材，每一步只推进一次不可逆烹饪状态；前一步残留进入下一步，最后由装盘和品尝证明成品。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One adult cook, kitchen and ingredient set persist.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult cook, kitchen and ingredient set persist."

invariants.rule: Every step creates an observable state change.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every step creates an observable state change."

invariants.rule: Previous-state material remains available to the next step.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Previous-state material remains available to the next step."

invariants.rule: Tool and container identity stay stable.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Tool and container identity stay stable."

invariants.rule: Plating and tasting provide final proof.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "Plating and tasting provide final proof."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
